snippet.title: Clomid Safety: Vision Changes and Warning Signs #Shorts
snippet.description:
Clomid (clomiphene) warning signs: blurred vision, flashes of light or spots in front of your eyes mean stopping the treatment and contacting your doctor promptly. Severe abdominal pain, rapid swelling of the belly or shortness of breath is a medical emergency; in an emergency call your local emergency number (911 in the US, 999 in the UK). Before every new treatment cycle, a pregnancy must be ruled out.

Full video: https://youtu.be/e3U7UdalWJs

Source: French prescribing information for clomiphene (ANSM, SmPC), section 4.4: https://base-donnees-publique.medicaments.gouv.fr/medicament/65338028/extrait
Prescribing rules differ between countries.

Dr Senai Aksoy, Associate Professor of Reproductive Medicine. This video is for education and information only. It is not personal medical advice, a diagnosis or a treatment recommendation. Do not start, stop or change medication based on this video without consulting your doctor.

This is an English-dubbed version of Dr Aksoy's original French educational video, using an AI voice based on Dr Aksoy's own voice. Lip movements were adjusted with AI to match the English audio. Humorous clips are illustrations and are labeled on screen.
